packageRules.description: The package smoke test uses locally packed Refit packages with a floating version.

Hold the Roslyn (Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.*) toolchain at its current versions for back-compatibility. The source generator builds against Roslyn 4.8 and ships in a single analyzer slot, which sets the minimum compiler version consumers need; the test tooling is deliberately clamped to 4.14.0 (while benchmark projects override Workspaces to match BenchmarkDotNet's transitive Roslyn dependency). These move together only as a deliberate toolchain bump, not via automated updates.
Keep the .NET Framework smoke test's SDK on .NET 11.
